furnitures.description: The room features a mix of seating options including a grey armchair with a fabric pattern that says 'DIESEL' on it, placed near a window. Nearby, there is a grey sofa with a yellow throw pillow. Additional seating includes a few modern chairs with a mix of wooden and fabric upholstery, one of which is a black seat with wooden legs and another with a blue seat.
furnitures.position: Left side near window, center, and right side near the dining area

furnitures.description: A wooden round dining table with four chairs around it, each having a mix of fabric and wooden finishes. Under the table, there are small stools.

The space includes several pieces of storage: a tall wooden cabinet next to the sofa, a small black metal stool, and a coffee table with a woven texture. There is also a wall-mounted shelf or cabinet with a modern design above the sofa, and a side table with books.
furnitures.position: Near the sofa, to the left of the dining table, on the walls, and along the room's perimeter

furnitures.description: The room has modern pendant lights hanging from the ceiling, which appear to be spherical in design. There is also a wall-mounted lamp and a large mirror.
furnitures.position: Over the dining table, near the sofa, and on the wall

furnitures.description: The decor includes a variety of elements: a large abstract geometric painting on the wall, various small plants and hanging planters, a round yellow woven rug, a round mirror on the wall, and a mix of natural and earthy tones with pops of color like the yellow throw pillow and blue chair.
furnitures.position: Wall, floor, and around the seating areas

furnitures.description: The flooring consists of light-colored, possibly wood or laminate, with a woven yellow rug near the sofa and a smaller woven rug under the dining table.
A flat-screen TV mounted on the wall near the sofa, and a small TV stand with books and decorative items.
furnitures.position: Left side near the sofa and on the side table

furnitures.description: Small decorative items like candle holders, small decorative plates, and a variety of knick-knacks on the wall-mounted cabinet and shelves. There are also some wall hooks with hanging items.
furnitures.position: Around the room, particularly on the cabinets and shelves

decorations.description: Large abstract geometric painting on the wall, featuring shades of blue, beige, and black.
decorations.position: Right side of the room, above the dining table

decorations.description: Several potted plants, including hanging and floor-standing types, providing greenery and a natural aesthetic.
decorations.position: Around the room, near the ceiling and on shelves

decorations.description: Two rugs: one large yellow woven rug near the sofa and a smaller one under the dining table.
decorations.position: Near the seating area and under the dining table
